added.title: Marketing Director, Occupier Advisory
added.description:
Job Title

Marketing Director, Occupier Advisory

Job Description Summary

The Marketing Director, Occupier Advisory is responsible for leading, developing, and executing a comprehensive strategic marketing plan for the Americas Occupier Advisory businesses, which include Tenant Representation and Strategic Consulting. This role will collaborate closely with business partners and the broader Marketing, Communications & Research organization to design and implement impactful marketing and sales enablement strategies that support fee earners and resonate with clients and prospects to drive revenue growth and elevate brand awareness.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Strategic Marketing Leadership

Create lasting value for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve by delivering innovative, people-focused solutions for the built world.
Deliver innovative strategies and tactics based on deep understanding of competitive landscape, industry trends, customer buyer behavior and personas, customer data, fee earner feedback, and market segmentation, etc.
Develop, execute, and continuously refine a robust strategic marketing plan, including specific marketing campaigns and sales enablement strategies, that aligns with the organization’s business goals and priorities.
Manage multiple verticals within Occupier Advisory to ensure marketing and sales enablement activities are tailored to each group's unique focus, client base, and market challenges.
Measure performance and analyze results to inform ongoing strategy adjustments and optimizations through KPIs such as campaign performance, fee earner feedback and adoption of tools and processes, customer feedback, etc.
Lead a high-performing team by fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability; provide strategic mentorship and development opportunities to support individual growth and elevate overall team performance.

Business Alignment And Collaboration

Partner with business leadership to understand strategic objectives and align marketing initiatives to support fee earners and revenue growth.
Champion marketing strategies that will deliver greatest impact on growth and return on investment and effort, influencing key business stakeholders to ensure alignment.
Leverage competitive, client, and market insights to inform strategies and optimize marketing investments.
Balance proactive strategic initiatives with reactive, tactical responses to market needs.

Integrated Marketing Coordination

Collaborate with internal Marketing, Communications & Research teams, as well as third party vendors, to integrate digital marketing, creative design, communications, and research into comprehensive content plans.
Drive engagement throughout the buying journey by delivering high-impact marketing content.
Partner with Marketing and Research leaders from other service lines to share best practices, gather competitive intelligence, and align on broader marketing strategies.

Thought Leadership And Industry Expertise

Lead strategies and tactics based on deep understanding of competitive landscape, industry trends, customer buyer behavior and personas, customer data, customer needs, and market segmentation to position C&W as the real estate advisor of choice and the premier industry thought leader to shape influence and reach key targets with differentiation.
Anticipate market opportunities and threats, providing strategic insights to enhance decision-making.

Performance Optimization

Optimize the effectiveness of marketing expenditures by leveraging key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and guide resource allocation.
Provide leadership and direction for marketing initiatives, ensuring adherence to corporate guidelines and consistent application of global brand standards.
Provide ongoing reporting of progress toward key objectives, milestones, success metrics and other evidence of performance, supported by data and constituent feedback.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field required.
8+ years of experience in marketing, preferably within commercial real estate.
Proven track record of serving as the primary marketing leader for an office, region, or revenue-focused business group.
Track record of successfully implementing and enforcing marketing procedures and achieving measurable results.
Demonstrated success in managing advertising, public relations, events, and business development activities.
Experience with digital marketing tools and strategies, including analytics and optimization.
High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interface effectively with clients and stakeholders at all levels.
Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a conceptual mindset.
Proven leadership skills, including stakeholder management, building relationships, and influencing peers and leaders.
Ability to work effectively in diverse cultural and educational environments.
High confidence, adaptability, and the ability to lead teams in dynamic and fast-paced settings.

Cushman & Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role.

The compensation for the position is: $ 131,750.00 - $155,000.00

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position at Cushman & Wakefield, please call the ADA line at 1-888-365-5406
or email Accommodations@cushwake.com. Please refer to the job title and job location when you contact us.

added.title: Principal, Marketing, Tri-Built
added.description:
QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What You'll Do

The Principal of TRI-BUILT Brand and Product Marketing owns the strategy and marketing performance of QXO's TRI-BUILT private-label portfolio. This individual contributor will strengthen the brand, accelerate product adoption, and lead integrated programs that support revenue, margin, penetration, and customer loyalty.

The role connects Marketing with Sales, Category Management, Supply Chain, Digital, Finance, Legal, Operations, manufacturers, and agency partners. The Principal will lead an expanding pipeline of product launches as TopBuild, Kodiak, and other products transition to TRI-BUILT branding.

The preferred location for this role is: Herndon, VA; Coppell, TX; and/or Atlanta, GA

Brand and Portfolio Strategy

Own and evolve the TRI-BUILT brand strategy, positioning, messaging, visual identity, and customer value proposition across categories and channels.
Develop annual marketing priorities, growth plans, budgets, and investment recommendations aligned with QXO revenue and margin objectives.
Build relationships with division, region, branch, and sales leaders and use field insight to shape practical programs that drive adoption.
Develop strategies that increase awareness, trial, repeat purchase, and share of wallet among priority customer segments.

Product Launches and Content

Lead go-to-market strategy for new products, category expansions, product transitions, and discontinuations.
Manage the launch roadmap for products transitioning to TRI-BUILT branding, including sequencing, dependencies, readiness, and field communications
Partner with Category Management and manufacturers to define target audiences, competitive positioning, key benefits, proof points, and launch requirements.
Oversee packaging, product data, images, installation guides, comparison tools, sell sheets, catalogs, and other product assets for accuracy and brand consistency.
Ensure QXO.com product listings and digital content are complete and ready for launch, resolving visibility and catalog issues with Digital and IT.

Campaigns and Field Enablement

Develop integrated campaigns and promotions that connect customer opportunities, product priorities, field execution, and measurable financial outcomes.
Own signature TRI-BUILT programs and partnerships, including Top Dogs, and guide participation in trade shows, branch activations, customer events, and branded merchandise.
Partner with Hispanic Marketing and channel leaders on culturally relevant, in-language campaigns, training, and digital experiences.
Equip sales and branch teams with practical tools, product resources, presentations, and training, supported by a consistent communication rhythm.

Performance and Cross Functional Leadership

Establish and report measures for TRI-BUILT sales, gross margin, penetration, customer adoption, campaign performance, and return on investment.
Analyze performance by division, region, branch, customer segment, and category to identify growth opportunities and recommend action.
Manage the TRI-BUILT marketing budget, forecasts, expenses, accruals, invoice approvals, and vendor-funded opportunities with Finance.
Lead through influence across internal teams, manufacturers, vendors, and agencies by setting clear priorities, owners, timelines, and quality expectations.

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
Seven or more years of progressive experience in brand management, product marketing, portfolio marketing, channel marketing, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated success developing marketing strategies tied to revenue, margin, product adoption, customer retention, or market-share outcomes.
Experience leading product launches and integrated B2B campaigns across digital, field, sales enablement, events, and communications channels.
Strong financial and analytical skills, including budget ownership, business-case development, forecasting, KPI design, and ROI analysis.
Excellent executive communication and influence skills, with the judgment to simplify complex issues and align senior stakeholders.
Credibility with field sales and operations teams and the ability to turn strategy into practical programs without formal authority.
Experience in building products, distribution, construction, manufacturing, private label, or another technical product environment is strongly preferred.

What you'll earn

401(k) with employer match
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
Paid training and certifications
Legal assistance and identity protection
Pet insurance
Employee assistance program (EAP)

QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

added.title: Marketing Coordinator - Taylor Oswald
added.description:
Job Summary

The Marketing Coordinator is responsible for supporting the full range of marketing, communications, and media functions through a defined set of corporate and administrative responsibilities, projects and tasks as assigned.

A Day In The Life

Supports the planning, budgeting, administration, and execution of all key department functions, including sales marketing campaigns, digital strategies, brand and graphic design, corporate and internal communications, event management, client entertainment, and corporate administration.
Participates as an active team member to ensure the accurate, effective, and timely delivery of high quality and consistent services.
Provides support and administrative service for all Taylor Oswald hosted events in collaboration with team and internal departments; proactively seeks ideas and opportunities to recommend new or enhance existing events.
Maintains an interactive planning calendar in real time that tracks all internal and external events along with individual marketing campaigns and projects; works closely with key department contacts to ensure awareness, status, and deadlines of all projects.
Coordinates with the Oswald marketing team and the Oswald Conference Centre including the event scheduling process and fulfillment, client communications, and the coordination of all operational details; secures and directs the needed internal and/or external support for Taylor Oswald Events (Information Technology, facilities, security, building management and maintenance, etc.).
Supports all Taylor Oswald internal events, programs, and corporate communications functions in collaboration with Marketing and Human Resources, including special meetings, company picnic and year-end celebrations.
Manages and executes the charitable and promotional request and budget tracking process; attends monthly charitable meetings and organizes and fulfills all charitable and promotional requests in collaboration with all involved parties.
Supports the promotional products program for Taylor Oswald-branded materials and all event-related needs, including tradeshow materials, invitations, and other marketing collateral pieces.
Manages expenditures and processing for promotional materials; serves as the liaison between vendor partners to survey internal client wants, anticipate needs, facilitate orders, negotiate rates, and resolve issues as they arise.
Supports the management, facilitation, delivery, payments, and fulfillment of all Taylor Oswald client entertainment programs, including sports and entertainment tickets and other available opportunities.
Performs key administrative functions of the department, including corporate AMEX and serves as an extension of the accounting AP and AR functions on behalf of the marketing and visibility budget, including but not limited to the coordination of invoice and payment details, input, and coding of marketing expenses into Workday, review and tracking of payments and other duties as assigned.
Supports the director on administrative tasks as needed, including calendar management and appointment setting, travel, and conference planning for the department.
Supports the Chief Marketing Officer on administrative tasks as needed, including calendar management and appointment setting, travel and conference planning and miscellaneous tasks as assigned.

What You’ll Need

Some general industry knowledge is preferred but not required. Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or public relations from a four-year college or university and one to three years or more of related experience or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

Prior Experience Specifically Required

Prior experience managing projects and tasks
Prior customer/client service experience

Who You Are

Strong interpersonal skills
Able to work effectively under tight deadlines
Patient and flexible in response to changes in direction
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Resourceful with an enthusiastic attitude
Dedicated to continual improvement in skills
Customer service oriented

Compensation

This role is compensated at up to
$60,000/yr commensurate with experience.

added.title: Integrated Marketing Senior Manager
added.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

The Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) team is a part of VBG. This role will be responsible for leading c ross-segment integrated marketing strategies and programs that would include initiatives touching Enterprise, Public Sector, and/or Business Markets across the CMO and Verizon Business Group. You will focus on marketing strategy, execution, performance management, and go-to-market plans relative to product launches, campaign pivots, and product promotions.

In this role, you will work in lockstep with Product Marketing, Demand Gen, CRM, Media, Creative, and Digital/Dotcom teams to build integrated programs in support of our Wireline Business. You will own internal communication of local campaign progress to all stakeholders, agency briefings, and GTM kickoffs while ensuring flawless execution. Additionally, you will serve as a flexible, agile contributor on the team, taking on other key IMC initiatives and special projects as business needs evolve. In this role, you will report to an Associate Director within the IMC segment team.

The IMC Senior Manager will lead the planning, briefing, management, execution, creative optimization, and reporting on Wireline multi-channel campaigns that drive to the sale funnel or direct to digital channels, increase awareness,and build long-term business relationships. You will have the authority and independence to ensure that requirements, communication opportunities, and risks are identified, managed, and completed in a timely fashion to achieve on-time completion of key deliverables.

Collaborating in lockstep with Product Marketing to define campaign objectives, align on strategies, and establish baseline briefs.
Partnering closely with the Media team to monitor campaign performance, track KPIs/GAs, and optimize local/regional media plans.
Working closely with Creative teams and agencies to analyze performance data and execute real-time creative pivots, A/B testing, and message testing when applicable.
Owning and managing the digital and Dotcom integration for your initiatives—ensuring seamless user journeys, landing page alignment, appointment-booking functionality, and strong cross-functional digital execution.
Authoring, owning, and presenting strategic briefs, local pilot presentations, and deck updates for multiple LOBs and leadership stakeholders.
Synthesizing media performance and local event ROI (GAs, leads, engagement) to share regular results, updates, and strategic recommendations out to leadership.
Managing complex, multi-faceted timelines with exceptional organizational skills to ensure all deliverables stay on strategy and on deadline.
Leading and supporting additional high-priority IMC initiatives and cross-functional projects outside of Wireline marketing as needed by the business.
Maintaining a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitive threats, and emerging trends to fill knowledge gaps and refine marketing strategy.

What We're Looking For…

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Experience working cross-functionally across Digital/Dotcom, Field Sales/Marketing, Product Marketing, and/or Media teams.
B2B Marketing experience.
Experience creating and presenting executive-level decks, performance readouts, and strategic briefs to Sr. Director-level leadership and above.
Experience translating market insights and data into compelling stories and sales enablement tools.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Master’s degree; preferably MBA.
Marketing experience in Wireline marketing, targeting Enterprise customers and prospects.
Experience working closely with Media and Creative teams to evaluate live campaign metrics and execute iterative creative pivots.
Strong organizational skills and proven ability to juggle multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Experience using generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Copilot) to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and support decision-making.
ABM/DBM/Content syndication experience.
Agency or consultant experience.
Proven digital/Dotcom marketing background with a solid understanding of web journeys, lead conversion pathways, and digital trends.
Strong project management background with high attention to detail and process optimization.
Agile mindset with the ability to easily adapt and step in on high-visibility adjacent projects.
Must be a team player and highly effective communicator capable of building strong cross-functional relationships.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

added.title: Director of Marketing and Social
added.description:
Full Time | Portland, OR | Primarily in office with hybrid flexibility
Reports to: Chief of Staff and President
ABOUT COLLiDE

COLLiDE brings sports, culture and community together through the Portland Pickles, Lake County Captains, Portland Bangers, Portland Cherry Bombs FC and Official League apparel. Our teams have distinct personalities, and we want our marketing to give people a reason to follow us, come to a game and be part of what we are building.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a creative leader to own social media strategy, content direction and audience growth across our teams. You will help our staff develop better ideas, grow our accounts and turn social attention into ticket and merchandise campaigns.

You should understand what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, share a post and follow an account. You will bring that knowledge into creative reviews, campaign planning and coaching, with clear expectations for quality, timing and results.

Your primary focus will be our four sports teams, with broader strategic support for Official League. You will manage approximately 2–3 direct reports and support a wider group of 5–8 staff. You will assign work, approve campaigns and help the existing team execute. Our advertising team will continue running paid ads, working from a coordinated campaign strategy.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead social media strategy and content

Own the social media strategy for each team, including Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook and YouTube. Set clear goals and tailor content to the audience and platform.
Lead creative reviews of concepts, hooks, captions, short videos and campaigns. Make curiosity a starting point and give people a reason to watch, share or participate.
Guide content planning, approvals and production timelines. Keep planned campaigns moving while leaving room to respond quickly to trends and cultural moments.
Study our strongest past posts and campaigns, understand why they worked and adapt those lessons while keeping each team's voice distinct.

Grow audiences and engagement

Build campaigns and recurring content that bring in new followers and keep existing fans involved throughout the year.
Set expectations for engaging with fans, responding to comments and messages, and joining relevant conversations. Build relationships with brands, creators and community accounts that can help us reach new people.
Review follower growth, reach, views, watch time, shares and comments. Identify what deserves another test, what to improve and what to stop.

Lead and support our staff

Give staff clear priorities, useful feedback and achievable deadlines. Hold regular check-ins, help remove obstacles and follow up on commitments.
Teach the strategy behind effective social content and campaigns. Encourage new ideas and help people develop their judgment and skills.
Coordinate with property GMs and department leaders so staff have the information, assets and support they need to deliver.

Turn social campaigns into sales

Work with ticketing and merchandise staff to build social campaigns around product launches, ticket offers, promotions and renewals.
Connect social content with email, websites, paid advertising and partner promotion. Set the audience, message, offer and timing before launch.
Track which campaigns generate interest, leads and purchases. Use the results to improve our approach and make good use of staff time and available budgets.

WHAT YOU BRING

At least 5 years of relevant marketing experience, including substantial responsibility for social media strategy and managing staff.
Examples of social accounts you helped grow and campaigns you personally led. Be ready to explain the creative idea, your role and the results.
Strong practical knowledge of social platforms, content formats, audience behavior and performance measurement. You keep learning as platforms and habits change.
A strong understanding of marketing strategy and how social content supports ticket sales, merchandise and long-term fan relationships.
Experience coaching people, giving direct feedback and holding a team accountable while supporting their growth.
The ability to turn an idea into a realistic plan, make timely decisions and work within available resources.
An open mind, strong creative judgment and willingness to test new ideas and challenge your own assumptions. Experience in sports, entertainment, live events or consumer brands is helpful.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Our social accounts are growing, reaching new people and giving fans reasons to engage and return.
Our content reflects each team's personality, creates curiosity and responds to opportunities while they still matter.
Staff have clear direction, improve their work and deliver campaigns on time with consistent support and accountability.
Social campaigns support ticket and merchandise sales, and we understand which efforts are working.

LOCATION AND BENEFITS

This role is based primarily in our Portland office, with hybrid flexibility and travel to Northeast Ohio and other COLLiDE markets.
Benefits include health insurance contributions, paid time off, merchandise discounts and lots of free tickets. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

Own the Pipeline. Drive the Growth. Redefine What Demand Generation Looks Like.

At Lifespace, Our Space is built on delivering meaningful experiences and that starts with how we attract, engage, and convert our future residents and customers. We’re looking for a Director Digital Marketing
who doesn’t just manage campaigns, you own outcomes.

This is a high impact leadership role for a marketer who thrives at the intersection of data, strategy, and execution, someone who knows how to turn media spend into qualified pipeline, measurable revenue, and scalable growth.

Why This Role Stands Out

About the Role and Why It Is A Little Different

Most marketing leadership ads want a one-person band. This one wants a conductor. We have a bench of specialist contractors, each a real expert in their own lane, spread worldwide. They need a leader who sets priorities, writes a clear brief, clears roadblocks, and knows great work when they see it.

Your mission: keep people coordinated, projects moving, deadlines visible, and results measurable. You do not need to be an expert in every marketing channel. You do need to be good at managing the experts who are.
If you enjoy managing many moving parts and turning them into a plan—and a plan into completed work—we should talk.

We are seeking a senior In-House Marketing Director to orchestrate our multi-channel growth engine. In this role, you will serve as the operational quarterback—managing specialized freelance contributors. You will set the creative brief, enforce brand/legal compliance for consistent messaging, audit contractor output, and execute and scale multi-channel acquisition and brand-awareness campaigns. In this role, you will bridge legal/tax expertise with high-impact digital marketing to grow B2C and B2B leads, dominate local search footprints, and produce authority-building content across video, webinar, and social channels.

You will work closely with leadership, our established LinkedIn marketing team, and various freelancers to turn specialized tax-bankruptcy thought leadership into measurable new leads.

About Tax Workout Group

Tax Workout Group is a growing national law firm focused on tax controversy and tax-motivated bankruptcy. We have expanded our office footprint and want to invest in a coordinated marketing operation to support the firm’s growth. We operate as a lean business, so we’re building our marketing team differently: one full-time leader coordinating a distributed network of specialist contractors. We rely on talented people who know their craft, and we need someone who can help them work together effectively.

We have one full-time marketing seat, and it is a leadership position. You will plan, assign, track, unblock, and evaluate the work of a distributed team, and you will be accountable for the results. Your marketing knowledge makes you good at it, but managing people and projects is the job.

Lead the team

Recruit, onboard, evaluate, and (when needed) replace contractors, mainly through Upwork and similar platforms
Turn marketing goals into clear, well-scoped briefs that a remote specialist can pick up and run with
Run several projects at once: set priorities, sequence the work, manage dependencies, and keep every workstream moving
Give specific, kind feedback, and hold people accountable for quality, deadlines, and results

Direct marketing and software projects

Oversee work across the lanes listed below, each carried out by the specialists who own it
Guide development of the custom, web-hosted marketing software we build and use, from requirements through release
Keep one current, honest view of status, risks, and deadlines for firm leadership

Measure, report, and stay compliant

Use analytics to judge both campaign performance and contractor performance
Deliver a consolidated monthly report of marketing spend across contractors, tools, and other expenses
Keep all marketing work in line with Florida Bar advertising rules

Stay hands-on where it’s quick

Handle small ad hoc requests that take five minutes instead of a day to write up for someone else. We love this, but it’s a bonus, not the job.

The Lanes Your Specialists Own

You’ll know each one well enough to set sound goals, ask good questions, tell great work from so-so work, and notice when a deadline has quietly wandered off.

Local office marketing (map and directory listings)
Social media, business-to-consumer
Social media, business-to-business
Email marketing
Webinars (event marketing)
Video marketing (YouTube, TikTok, and video embedded in other channels)
Public relations (primarily press releases)
Reputation management (soliciting and responding to customer reviews)
Organic SEO and content marketing
Paid search advertising
Measurement, reporting, and analytics

What We’re Looking For - Project management comes first.
We’re looking for someone with experience managing multiple projects at once, coordinating multiple contributors, and delivering results.

You should bring:
Demonstrated experience managing projects, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.
Experience coordinating remote contractors, freelancers, or distributed teams.
Strong delegation, written communication, follow-through, and problem-solving skills.
Enough marketing-generalist knowledge to understand what specialists are doing, evaluate their work, and ask intelligent questions.
Comfort with project management tools, performance metrics, budgets, and status reporting.
The ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and bring structure to an evolving operation.
Flexibility for occasional meetings outside conventional business hours.

Especially valuable experience

Experience managing software development projects, marketing projects, multiple teams, parallel projects, remote contributors, and international teams
would be particularly valuable.
Law firm marketing experience, familiarity with digital marketing analytics, and practical use of generative AI tools are additional pluses.

What You Don’t Need to Be - You do not need to personally run every ad campaign, write every article, edit every video, or become the world’s leading authority on all things SEO. You do need to know enough to manage the people who handle those tasks, and it helps to be able to knock out a quick task yourself when that’s more efficient.

What Success Looks Like - Our contractors know what to do. Projects don’t disappear into the void. Deadlines and budgets are managed. Problems surface early. Marketing initiatives move forward in parallel, and management can see results.

Fully remote:
Work from your home office.
US-based applicants only.

Full-time employment.

Ready to Apply?

Concrete examples of projects you’ve successfully delivered are especially helpful. We’re looking for a thoughtful, organized, proactive leader who enjoys making complicated things work better. If you can bring order to a dozen moving parts without becoming one more moving part yourself, we’d love to hear from you.

About Us

GrowthMed is an established digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, paid advertising, website development, and digital marketing solutions for medical practices, particularly in the plastic surgery and aesthetic medicine industries.

to take ownership of our day-to-day operations, manage our teams, and ensure everything is running efficiently.

About the Role

We are looking for someone who knows how to run a digital marketing agency, not just manage projects.

The ideal candidate is a natural leader who can confidently manage multiple departments, delegate responsibilities, solve problems, make independent decisions, and hold team members accountable.
You'll serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, and internal teams, ensuring projects are completed on time, clients are receiving excellent
service, and our agency is consistently delivering high-quality results.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who takes initiative, thinks independently, and knows how to get things done without constant oversight.

You'll report directly to company leadership and have the authority to manage daily operations, set priorities, and implement improvements.

Key ResponsibilitiesTeam Management & Leadership

Oversee and coordinate our SEO, PPC, content, web development, design, and client success teams.
Delegate responsibilities, assign priorities, and ensure team members understand expectations and deadlines.
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal questions, operational challenges, and escalations.
Hold employees and contractors accountable for their work, productivity, and performance.
Conduct regular team check-ins and performance reviews.
Identify staffing needs, performance issues, and opportunities to improve team efficiency.

Agency Operations & Project Oversight

Take ownership of the agency's daily operations and ensure all departments are functioning efficiently.
Oversee multiple client accounts and projects simultaneously.
Ensure deliverables are completed accurately, on time, and according to company standards.
Proactively identify bottlenecks, missed deadlines, and operational problems before they become larger issues.
Develop and improve internal workflows, processes, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Establish clear accountability across departments.
Make independent operational decisions and resolve issues without requiring constant approval from leadership.

SEO, PPC & Digital Marketing Oversight

Oversee the execution and performance of SEO strategies, Google Ads campaigns, website projects, and content marketing initiatives.
Understand digital marketing best practices well enough to evaluate team performance, identify problems, and recommend solutions.
Ensure SEO campaigns are progressing, websites are functioning properly, and advertising campaigns are being monitored and optimized.
Review key performance indicators, including organic traffic, keyword rankings, lead generation, conversion rates, and campaign performance.
Work with department specialists to troubleshoot performance issues and implement improvements.
Ensure marketing strategies align with client goals and expectations.

Client Account & Service Delivery Management

Ensure clients consistently receive high-quality work and excellent service.
Oversee the client success team and ensure client requests are handled promptly and professionally.
Monitor outstanding client issues, support requests, and project timelines.
Step in to resolve escalated client concerns when necessary.
Identify accounts at risk of dissatisfaction or cancellation and proactively implement solutions.
Ensure teams follow through on client commitments and maintain clear communication.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Track department performance, project progress, and team productivity.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs).
Provide concise, organized weekly reports to company leadership.
Highlight important accomplishments, outstanding issues, missed deadlines, client concerns, and recommended improvements.
Present solutions and recommendations rather than simply reporting problems.
Identify opportunities to improve productivity, service quality, and profitability.

Qualifications

Required:

7+ years of experience in digital marketing, with significant experience in an agency environment.
3+ years in a senior management, operations, or agency leadership role.
Proven experience managing multiple departments, employees, and contractors.
Strong working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads/PPC, website development, content marketing, and digital marketing analytics.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage operations, delegate responsibilities, and make sound business decisions.
Experience overseeing multiple client accounts and competing deadlines.
Excellent organizational, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Strong understanding of project management systems, operational workflows, and performance reporting.
Ability to hold team members accountable and address performance issues directly.
Comfortable managing remote teams and coordinating across different time zones.

Preferred:

Previous experience as an Agency Operations Director, General Manager, Head of Operations, or similar leadership position.
Experience working at an SEO-focused or full-service digital marketing agency.
Experience managing offshore or international teams.
Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, and common SEO reporting tools.
Experience with project management platforms such as Trello, Asana, ClickUp, or Monday.com.
Experience in healthcare, medical, or aesthetic marketing.
Experience building SOPs, improving operational systems, and scaling agency operations.

What We're Looking For

Beyond your qualifications, we're looking for someone who:

Takes ownership:
You don't wait to be told what to do. You identify what needs attention and take action.
Makes decisions:
You're comfortable using your judgment, solving problems, and moving things forward independently.
Knows how to delegate:
You understand how to manage people effectively without micromanaging.
Holds people accountable:
You're comfortable setting expectations, following up, and addressing underperformance.
Is proactive, not reactive:
You anticipate problems and address them before they escalate.
Pays attention to details:
You notice when something isn't right, whether it's a missed deadline, a client issue, or a decline in campaign performance.
Communicates clearly:
You know how to keep leadership informed without overwhelming them with unnecessary details.
Gets things done:
You're results-oriented, resourceful, and committed to finding solutions.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, we would expect you to:
Gain a thorough understanding of our team structure, client accounts, services, and existing workflows.
Establish clear reporting and accountability across departments.
Take ownership of daily team management, delegation, and project oversight.
Identify operational inefficiencies and begin implementing improvements.
Become the primary point of contact for internal team questions and day-to-day decisions.

Ultimately, your success will be measured by how effectively the agency operates under your leadership, the performance and accountability of our teams, the quality of our client service, and your ability to keep the business running smoothly without requiring constant involvement from ownership.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction describing your experience managing operations at a digital marketing or SEO agency.

We would especially love to hear about the size of the teams you've managed, the departments you've overseen, and examples of how you've independently improved agency operations.

added.title: Senior Funnel & Marketing Systems Engineer
added.description:
Senior Funnel & Marketing Systems Engineer
Launch OS Marketing

ABOUT LAUNCH OS MARKETING

Launch OS Marketing helps high-ticket businesses scale through performance marketing, conversion-focused funnels, and reliable marketing systems.

We’re building something big, and we’re looking for A players who want to help build it—people who take pride in their work, bring ideas to the table, and take ownership of results.

If your goal is simply to clock in, complete assigned tasks, and clock out, this role won’t be the right fit. We want someone who identifies opportunities, solves problems, communicates proactively, and follows through.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Senior Funnel & Marketing Systems Engineer owns the technical journey from ad click to application, booked call, follow-up, and recorded sale.

You’ll turn approved copy, offer direction, and client assets into polished, conversion-focused funnels. You’ll also build and maintain the CRM workflows, integrations, attribution, and dashboards behind them.

This is a hands-on role spanning both frontend execution and backend systems. You should be equally comfortable improving a mobile page layout, diagnosing a broken integration, and verifying that a sales dashboard reflects accurate numbers.

You’ll manage technical delivery across six to eight clients, balancing new builds, onboarding projects, ongoing improvements, and maintenance.

You own the complete, tested result—not just your portion of the task list.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build conversion-focused funnels. Develop landing pages, sales pages, applications, booking flows, checkout flows, and supporting pages for DSL/VSL, webinar, challenge, quiz, advertorial, free-training, and low-to-high-ticket ascension funnels.
• Own design and frontend execution. Translate approved copy and client assets into intentional layouts with strong typography, spacing, visual hierarchy, and clear calls to action. Build responsive experiences using platform tools and custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Build and maintain GoHighLevel and HubSpot systems. Configure forms, custom fields, pipelines, qualification logic, lead routing, sales assignments, calendars, and lifecycle stages.
• Develop email and SMS automations. Build nurture, booking, reminder, no-show, follow-up, and reactivation workflows with appropriate triggers, branches, timing, and stopping conditions.
• Connect the tools behind the funnel. Implement integrations through Zapier, APIs, webhooks, and tools such as SendBlue. Maintain accurate field mappings, prevent duplicate actions, and troubleshoot failed transfers.
• Implement attribution and conversion tracking. Support primarily Meta-driven acquisition by preserving campaign information, validating conversion events, and connecting marketing activity to CRM outcomes.
• Build sales and attribution dashboards. Provide visibility into leads, qualified applications, bookings, attendance, sales, ad spend, and collected revenue. Define metrics clearly and reconcile reporting against source records.
• Own quality control. Test the customer journey, page behavior, data flow, and automation logic before handoff. Verify that systems continue working after launch.
• Manage delivery proactively. Scope work, provide realistic estimates, track dependencies, and communicate progress, blockers, and capacity concerns early.
• Improve how we build. Create reusable components, documented workflows, checklists, and processes that increase speed and reliability across client accounts.

REQUIREMENTS

• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining direct-response funnels for high-ticket businesses.
• Strong hands-on experience in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including their workflows, CRM structures, and integration capabilities.
• Strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills for custom layouts, responsive behavior, forms, and troubleshooting.
• Strong visual judgment. You understand spacing, typography, hierarchy, and consistency, and can produce polished pages without needing a detailed mockup for every build.
• Practical understanding of conversion rate optimization, including message continuity, credibility, form friction, and clear next steps.
• Experience with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and field mapping, including investigating failed or duplicated data transfers.
• Experience implementing attribution and building dashboards that connect marketing activity with sales outcomes.
• A repeatable process for testing, documentation, and quality control.
• The ability to prioritize across multiple clients and manage competing deadlines.
• Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues to nontechnical teammates.
• Experience using Codex, Claude Code, or comparable AI development tools effectively.

Our standard for automation is simple:

If you don’t know how to do something manually, you cannot automate it.

You must understand the underlying process, explain the logic you implement, and troubleshoot the systems you build. We expect you to use modern tools effectively and take responsibility for everything you ship.

QUALITY STANDARDS

Quality control is part of the build. Before handing work over, you should have checked:

• Desktop and mobile layouts, spacing, typography, links, and calls to action.
• Forms, validation, submissions, bookings, and checkouts where applicable.
• Field mappings, qualification rules, pipeline stages, and owner assignments.
• Workflow branches, delays, re-entry, and duplicate submissions.
• Messaging eligibility and stopping conditions after bookings, replies, or opt-outs.
• Attribution data, conversion events, and reporting accuracy.
• Failure handling and recovery for unsuccessful integrations.

You should be able to show what you tested, what passed, and what still needs attention.

EXPECTED RESULTS

• Polished funnels: Pages look intentional, work across devices, and require minimal avoidable rework.
• Reliable launches: Builds meet agreed requirements and timelines, with risks communicated early.
• Dependable automations: Leads reach the correct destination, follow-up reflects their current status, and failures are visible and recoverable.
• Accurate reporting: Dashboards use clearly defined metrics and numbers that reconcile with underlying records.
• Clear communication: The Growth Marketing Manager and CMO know what is complete, what is next, and what needs a decision.
• Stronger processes: Reusable systems and documentation improve delivery speed and reduce recurring mistakes.
• Proactive improvement: You identify issues and opportunities before someone has to assign them to you.

CORE VALUES

Extreme Ownership
Take responsibility for the outcome. Clarify expectations, follow through, and own the resolution when something goes wrong.

Initiative and Resourcefulness
Investigate unfamiliar problems, consult documentation, test your assumptions, and bring a recommended solution.

High Standards
Care about the details. Check your work thoroughly and take pride in delivering something the team can trust.

Clear, Direct Communication
Give honest updates, raise concerns early, and explain tradeoffs clearly. Speak up when you see a better approach.

Speed With Discipline
Move with urgency while protecting the quality of the result. Build efficient processes that reduce rework.

Continuous Improvement
Seek feedback, sharpen your skills, and turn lessons into better systems for the entire team.

SCHEDULE

• 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Mountain Time.
• Availability to support critical launches or events when needed.
• Proactive communication around priorities, deadlines, and availability.

LOCATION AND EMPLOYMENT TYPE

• Fully remote, United States.
• Full-time employee position.

REPORTING

This role reports to the Growth Marketing Manager and CMO and works closely with the team responsible for client strategy and delivery.

COMPENSATION

• $95,000–$110,000 USD annual base salary, based on experience.
• Revenue-share bonus tied to your assigned pod of clients.

The revenue-share structure and payout terms will be discussed during the hiring process.

BENEFITS

• Paid time off.
• Company-wide paid holidays.
• $3,000 annual investment budget for tools, resources, and gear that support your work and professional growth.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:

1. A two-to-five-minute Loom introduction. Introduce yourself, describe your current or most recent position, explain what you personally owned and were responsible for, and tell us what you’re looking for in your next role.
2. Two relevant funnel examples. Explain your contribution to the design, development, backend, and tracking. Redacted walkthroughs are welcome where client work is confidential.
3. One automation or integration example. Describe the problem, the systems involved, the logic you built, and how you verified it worked.
4. A brief explanation of your quality-control process. Include a checklist or example if available.
5. Your availability and potential start date.

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment and live technical review focused on funnel execution, automation, troubleshooting, and quality control.

We want to see how you think, how you build, and how you prove your work is ready.

added.title: Manager, Marketing Data & Analytics
added.description:
Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?

Make an impact. Join PMI.

How will you make a difference to PMI?

The Manager, Marketing Data and Analytics owns the business data architecture and metric definitions behind Marketing's numbers, and leads the team that measures Marketing. The role defines how marketing, customer, product, and revenue data should be modeled, decides what each metric means, and ensures those definitions are implemented consistently across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language analytics.

The role combines hands-on technical depth with team leadership. The individual is expected to be advanced in SQL, to design analytical data models, and to profile, reconcile, and diagnose data directly, so they can specify what engineering builds and verify that the result represents the business correctly. They are equally expected to lead three to four analysts, set the standards those analysts work to, and develop the team's technical capability.

Data Engineering and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. This role represents Marketing in the design of the data layer, writes the specifications those teams build against, and is accountable for ensuring the resulting data products correctly represent the business.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

Business Data Architecture, Metric Definitions, and Context

Own Marketing's canonical metric definitions and the business logic the governed semantic layer implements, and arbitrate those definitions when marketing, finance, and reporting platforms disagree.
Specify the semantic models for the most complex and cross-domain marketing use cases, and validate what the Snowflake team builds against that specification.
Own the business data architecture for Marketing, defining the facts, dimensions, grain, relationships, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions that connect marketing, customer, product, transaction, and engagement data.
Design analytical models that answer cross-domain questions spanning acquisition, engagement, conversion, certification, membership, renewal, and revenue.
Write advanced SQL to profile data, validate sources, reconcile metrics, build reusable datasets, and investigate complex customer and business questions.
Determine what unstructured content, such as business documentation, definitions, and prior analyses, must be retrievable alongside structured metrics for natural-language and agent-based analysis, and maintain source-to-metric mappings and lineage.
Own the business questions, expected results, and synonym glossary behind the Verified Query Repository supporting Cortex Analyst and natural-language analytics.
Own the context layer that makes Marketing's data interpretable to analysts and AI agents, including entity descriptions, metric documentation, approved analytical uses, and known limitations of each source.
Diagnose discrepancies across Snowflake, BI, Adobe Analytics, marketing platforms, finance reporting, and operational systems.
Identify gaps in source data, identity resolution, event structures, and dimensional consistency before they become downstream reporting issues.
Define ownership boundaries between source systems, engineered data products, semantic models, and reporting layers.

Team Leadership and Capability

Lead, coach, and develop a team of three to four analysts spanning paid media, customer and lifecycle analytics, and digital analytics.
Set the Marketing Analytics roadmap, allocate the team against it, and manage intake and prioritization from across Marketing.
Establish and enforce analytical standards including SQL quality, peer review, testing, documentation, and reuse.
Review the team's models, queries, and analyses before they reach stakeholders, and hold the quality bar for what gets published.
Grow the team's depth in dimensional modeling, data modeling practice, and analytical rigor through direct coaching and review.
Manage performance, hiring, and development planning for the team.

Marketing Measurement and Performance Analytics

Define and govern core marketing KPIs including revenue, conversion, CAC and CPA, ROAS, retention, funnel progression, pacing to plan, and channel efficiency.
Own the integrity and narrative of recurring executive performance reporting, including monthly business reviews and QBR analytics, with the team producing the underlying analysis.
Determine how platform-reported, attribution-based, financial, and incrementality-based measures reconcile, and establish where each is appropriately used.
Lead attribution, cohort, and incrementality work so it produces decision-grade guidance on marketing investment, building the harder analyses directly.
Own predictive modeling for Marketing, including membership churn and renewal propensity, certification lapse and recertification likelihood, and product and cross-sell propensity, alongside segmentation, lifecycle, and cohort analysis across CRM, web, campaign, commerce, certification, and membership data.
Define the features, target definitions, validation approach, and performance thresholds for predictive models, determine when a score is reliable enough to act on, and establish how scores are refreshed, monitored for drift, and activated in campaign, lifecycle, and retention programs.
Set analytical standards for A/B testing, holdouts, geo experiments, and conversion-lift studies within the marketing analytics practice, including hypotheses, test populations, success metrics, and readouts.
Partner with Product and Marketing to define measurable funnels, customer states, lifecycle stages, and behavioral signals for considered-purchase journeys, and hold a clear distinction between attribution, correlation, prediction, and causal measurement when results are communicated.

Analytics Delivery and Enablement

Govern Marketing's analytical products in enterprise BI and visualization platforms, ensuring definitions are sourced from the semantic layer rather than rebuilt in the tool.
Use Adobe Analytics to investigate digital behavior, traffic, customer journeys, and conversion performance, and work with data from Adobe Experience Platform, CRM, commerce, and paid media systems.
Apply working knowledge of digital event instrumentation, tagging, identity, and schemas to identify measurement and architecture issues at the source, and establish where AI-assisted tooling is applied to SQL development, analysis, documentation, and testing.
Expand governed self-service and AI-assisted analytics for Marketing across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language surfaces, and represent Marketing data and context requirements in the Marketing AI reference architecture.
Define what Marketing data and context AI agents and natural-language tools are permitted to reach, at what grain, and under what access and accuracy controls, and own the evaluation approach that tests answer accuracy before release and monitors it as data and definitions change.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as Marketing's primary analytical counterpart to Data Engineering, Data Architecture, and Data Governance.
Translate business questions into analytical requirements and data-product specifications that engineering can build against.
Partner with Data Engineering on transformation logic, data contracts, source integration, model design, and data-quality requirements.
Partner with Performance Marketing, Brand, Digital, Product, Lifecycle, and Regional Marketing on measurement needs and analytical priorities.
Present analytical findings, performance trends, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Scope of Role

Leads a team of three to four analysts covering marketing, customer, and performance analytics, while personally designing analytical data models and validating them. Accountable for Marketing's business data architecture, metric definitions, context layer, predictive models, and executive performance reporting across certification, membership, e-learning, events, and other product lines.

Hands-on ownership concentrates in data model design, metric reconciliation, predictive model validation, evaluation of analytical accuracy, and diagnosis of cross-system discrepancies. Semantic view implementation sits with the Snowflake team, built to this role's specification. Routine reporting, campaign analysis, and dashboard production sit with the team, under this role's review and standards.

Data Engineering, Technology, and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, platform access, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. Enterprise data governance policy, cataloging, and cross-domain stewardship sit outside this role; the incumbent partners with Data Governance and applies those standards within Marketing.

Role Qualifications

10+ years across marketing analytics, customer analytics, analytics engineering, or related disciplines, including prior leadership of an analytics team.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing an analytics team while remaining hands-on technically.
Working knowledge of ETL and ELT concepts, transformation pipelines, data dependencies, and data-quality controls, with the ability to read, review, and challenge logic developed by engineering teams.
Experience working within layered, dimensional, or medallion data architectures.
Experience integrating and analyzing data across CRM, marketing, digital, commerce, and transactional systems.
Development and governance of analytical products in an enterprise BI platform, preferred.
Customer data platform architecture including identity resolution, event schema design, and audience activation.
Marketing measurement including attribution, experimentation, incrementality, conversion, CAC and CPA, and ROAS, and experience directing or building predictive and propensity models such as churn or retention.
Advanced SQL including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, transformations, data profiling, reconciliation, and validation, applied to large-scale datasets.
Working hands-on experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform, sufficient to profile, query, validate, and reconcile at scale.
Demonstrated experience designing business and analytical data models, and specifying them for engineering teams to build against.
Dimensional modeling including facts, dimensions, grain, cardinality, slowly changing dimensions, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions.
Metric governance, lineage, and reconciliation across multiple enterprise systems.
Strong analytical storytelling and executive communication.
Familiarity with semantic layer and context technologies such as Snowflake Semantic Views, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, dbt Semantic Layer, or Looker, preferred.
Digital analytics using an enterprise web analytics platform, preferred.
dbt or comparable SQL transformation framework, preferred.
Python or R for advanced analysis, automation, or modeling, preferred.
Git and version-controlled analytics development, preferred.
Data testing and observability frameworks, preferred.
Marketing mix modeling, geo experimentation, conversion lift, causal-inference methods, and machine learning applied to churn, propensity, or lifetime value, preferred.
Up to 10% if required.

What you can expect from us

We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you..

Join Us And You’ll Get

an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location.
skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future.
access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience.
flexible options to help balance work time and your time

Job Summary

Collen is hiring a Marketing, Business Development & Administration Coordinator to support its growth teams. In short, this is a hybrid of bid support, marketing and office coordination. Above all, the role centres on prequalification submissions, which help a contractor qualify to tender for new projects. In addition, you will keep records accurate, organise meetings and events, and support senior stakeholders. Therefore, it suits an organised communicator who enjoys detail as much as variety.

About Collen And The Team

Collen is a long-established construction and engineering company, and it also operates outside Ireland, including in Sweden. Because the business competes for major projects, strong prequalification work has a direct impact on which contracts the company can bid for. As a result, this role sits at the point where marketing, data and new business meet.

In practice, you will work closely with directors, managers and several internal teams. For example, you will gather staff CVs, qualifications and performance data for submissions. Meanwhile, you will also prepare presentations and marketing materials, and you will help run company events, some of them international.

Responsibilities

Marketing and business development

Prepare prequalification applications and support related business development activities.
Maintain and update client databases and business development records.
Keep staff CVs, experience and qualification records ready for prequalification submissions.
Track prequalification performance data and prepare reports on it.
Maintain employee CPD records where required.
Develop marketing materials, presentations and company information.
Help organise and coordinate company marketing events.
Support the management of international events.

Administration and coordination

Provide day-to-day administrative support to directors, managers and teams.
Coordinate meetings, including scheduling, logistics, documents and minute-taking where required.
Prepare reports, presentations, correspondence and other business documents.
Maintain organised records, filing systems and document-control processes.
Manage calendars, appointments and meeting arrangements where required.
Handle confidential and business-sensitive information with discretion.
Support internal and external communications and stakeholder coordination.
Assist with general office administration and ad hoc tasks.

Minimum Qualifications

Previous experience in a marketing, business development or administrative support role.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands.
A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
The ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

A qualification in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Experience with CRM or document-management systems.

Beyond the skills above, Collen also looks for a professional, proactive and service-focused approach. Similarly, problem-solving, initiative and discretion with confidential information all matter in this role.

Salary and benefits

The advert does not state a salary range or any benefits . Likewise, it does not confirm the contract type, working hours or work model. Therefore, raise these points with Collen’s recruitment team early in the process.

Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

What are prequalification submissions in this role?

They are documents a contractor submits to show its capability before it can tender for a project. In this role, you will compile staff CVs, qualifications and performance data for them. Consequently, accuracy and good record-keeping are central to the job.

Do I need a marketing degree to apply?

No. Collen lists a qualification in Marketing, Communications or Business Administration as desirable, not essential. However, you do need previous experience in a marketing, business development or administrative support role.

Will this role involve travel?

Possibly. The advert mentions support for international event management, and Collen operates outside Ireland. Still, it does not say how much travel is involved

TeamMate, a business unit of Wolters Kluwer, is seeking an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist focused on paid digital advertising to plan, execute, and optimize global B2B campaigns that build awareness, generate qualified demand, and contribute to pipeline growth. The ideal candidate is a performance-driven B2B marketer who combines strong campaign execution skills with analytical thinking. Working as part of the advertising team and under the direction of the advertising lead, this person will support audience and keyword development, collaborate on ad creatives and landing pages, execute tests, monitor campaign performance, and recommend practical optimizations within established strategies and budgets.

About Us

Wolters Kluwer TeamMate is a global leader in audit management, assurance and GRC software, serving customers in over 150 countries. TeamMate solutions help audit, risk, compliance, controls and GRC teams drive efficiency, insight, and value. This role will help expand TeamMate’s digital reach, engage priority audiences, and support growth across the audit, governance, risk, compliance, and information security markets.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze campaign results and provide concise insights and recommendations to improve targeting, creative, conversion, and investment efficiency

Demonstrated experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn advertising campaigns from planning through optimization and reporting

Experience monitoring media budgets, pacing investment, forecasting performance, and making data-based recommendations

Experience with landing-page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization is preferred
