This is where
your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Summary

Baxter is committed to driving connectivity for patients, clinicians, and customers across healthcare settings. Baxter’s Connected Care Group
focuses on two critical areas: (1) Digital Products
, delivering connected devices and software to customers, and (2) Digital Platforms
, facilitating software development across Baxter’s medical devices with a unified architecture to accelerate customer-focused solutions. The portfolio includes key offerings that drive revenue and advance Baxter’s mission to save and sustain lives while shaping the future of healthcare.

The Director of Marketing, Connected Care Group serves as the marketing leader for Baxter's Connected Care portfolio, responsible for shaping portfolio growth strategy, customer adoption, market expansion, and commercial performance across Digital Products and Digital Platforms. In partnership with Product Management, Sales, and other cross-functional teams, this leader translates market opportunities, customer insights, and competitive dynamics into portfolio strategies that accelerate revenue growth, strengthen customer value realization, and expand market penetration.

This role owns portfolio positioning, marketing strategy, customer adoption strategy, and commercial growth initiatives while leading upstream and downstream marketing teams. The Director will modernize marketing capabilities through data-driven decision making, AI-enabled marketing approaches, customer adoption strategies, and scalable commercial processes that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.

This role sits within the Connected Care Group and reports into the Senior Director of Product Management. There will be a team of 2-5 direct reports that will be responsible for driving growth of the portfolio. Key stakeholders in the Connected Care Group include Product Management, Sales, Marketing Communications (MarCom), Project Management, Operations, and R&D. Across the broader organization, she/he will also interact with other marketing, product management, medical affairs, sales, regional, and quality teams. She/he will have responsibility to communicate milestones and progress to BU leadership and executives as appropriate.

To be successful, this leader must balance near-term commercial priorities with long-term portfolio growth and market development objectives. The ideal candidate will be a strategic and data-driven marketing leader who can influence across a matrixed organization, build high-performing teams, and drive measurable business outcomes through modern marketing capabilities and customer-centric growth strategies.

This role requires adaptability in a fast-paced and evolving environment, balancing strategic leadership with operational engagement. Success requires a highly collaborative, visible leader who can effectively influence across virtual and in-person teams while navigating changing business priorities. While this is primarily a strategic leadership role, the Director is expected to remain close to execution and contribute directly where appropriate to ensure speed, quality, and alignment with business priorities. We are seeking a collaborative, high-energy, and agile individual who has an in-depth knowledge of the healthcare and technology ecosystem.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Shape portfolio growth strategy and influence business unit priorities through market insights, customer understanding, competitive intelligence, and commercial analytics.
Lead upstream and downstream marketing teams to drive portfolio adoption, market expansion, customer value realization, and revenue growth across Connected Care offerings.
Build and modernize marketing capabilities, including customer adoption programs, digital and AI-enabled marketing approaches, commercial analytics, and scalable demand generation processes.
Ensure alignment between product strategy and commercial execution through effective positioning, go-to-market strategies, and cross-functional leadership.
Develop and lead a high-performing marketing organization while managing marketing investment to maximize business impact and ROI.

Marketing Capability and Commercial Transformation

Lead the modernization of marketing across Connected Care through data-driven decision making, AI-enabled marketing approaches, digital engagement strategies, and scalable commercial processes.
Establish metrics and analytics that connect marketing investments to customer adoption, pipeline creation, revenue growth, and marketing ROI.
Drive continuous improvement of marketing operations, customer journey management, demand generation, and portfolio performance measurement.

Upstream Marketing

Lead market and customer insight generation and partner with Product Management and business leadership to translate those insights into portfolio strategy, product investment priorities, market expansion opportunities, and long-term growth initiatives.
Own portfolio-level positioning and narrative, ensuring clear articulation of platform value and differentiation across interconnected solutions.
Analyze market size, growth, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic priorities; develop deep subject matter expertise across the portfolio.
Capture and communicate customer intelligence and other learnings back across the Baxter organization.
Understand key growth drivers and pricing.
Clarify the portfolio and product-specific value propositions and positioning relative to customer pain points and competitors.
Segment customers and inform priorities.
Understand decision-making and purchasing processes for customers.
Help craft internal and external messaging.
Develop OUS marketing plan and enable growth outside developed markets.
Create multi-year plans to build the Connected Care brand through a long- term marketing strategy.
Manage 1-3 Upstream Marketing individuals

Downstream Marketing

Ensure the organization has effective marketing processes, tools, content, and enablement capabilities required to support commercial success
Communicate and implement messaging across functional and geographic partners – and help shape their communications.
Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns, content, and omnichannel strategies to drive awareness, demand generation, and sales enablement.
Develop segment-specific messaging, value propositions, and clinical/economic narratives to drive targeted campaigns and market engagement.
Deliver high-quality pre launch, launch, and post-launch promotional programs that maximize product adoption and penetration within the market.
Support regional commercial marketing teams to help achieve growth and profitability with support for messaging.
Work cross-functionally with business units, region/country teams, and functions to brainstorm, develop, launch new processes and improvements.
Work with internal teams to develop clinical and economic messaging.
Lead product launches, field sales support, and other marketing activities.
Generate/analyze competitive intelligence and promote understanding of competitive tactics with the sales team.
Partner with marketing communications to create innovative and forward-looking content to drive market awareness, lead generation, leading to deal closure.
Develop relationships and regularly interact with customers through presentations, interviews, tradeshows, professional societies, and site visits.
Collaborate with global portfolio marketing to understand issues related to product quality/customer complaints; ensure feedback is communicated back to respective owners for input into recommendations and resolution to identified issues.
Manage agencies and external stakeholders where needed.
Collaborate with Medical Affairs to aid in guiding high-value studies to support key claims in marketing materials and establish Baxter’s presence as a thought leader.
Manage 1-3 Downstream Marketing individuals.

Qualifications

Experience marketing complex, software-enabled or platform-based healthcare solutions, with a demonstrated ability to drive enterprise adoption.
Strong understanding of digital health ecosystems, including interoperability, clinical workflows, and enterprise IT environments.
Highly organized, self-starter who can lead and collaborate across the organization effectively.
Ability to operate with ambiguity in volatile environments, leading a function in and through the face of change, setting clear direction and guidance for the team you lead.
Ability to work and influence across business units and functions. Demonstrated track-record of leading and influencing in a matrixed environment.
Excellent written & verbal communication and presentation skills
Needs to work independently without supervision on most initiatives.
Team player with a strategic partnership mindset.
Must be available to travel to customer sites and team meetings frequently.
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset.
Ability to prioritize and influence others while exercising proper judgement for sound decision making and trade-off analysis.
Strong ability to communicate effectively at all levels inside and outside of the organization.
Strong work ethic and comfort with ambiguity.
Experience and knowledge of trends shaping product development and customer behavior.
Take a collaborative approach by openly discussing issues in a way that brings out the best thinking, attitude, and performance in others. Works effectively and productively with others running functional and support areas. Consider effect of decisions on other parts of the company.
Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, including international.

Education And Experience

10+ years marketing experience (preferably in Healthcare IT) with a proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing campaigns.
10+ years of direct and cross-functional leadership
Technical understanding of IT and connected care environments and robust knowledge of clinical processes and workflows. Understanding of IP networking and enterprise IT/IoT solutions. Understanding of cloud and on-prem solutions.
Demonstrated career progression in previous roles.

added.description:
At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. Job Title

Marketing Specialist

Company

Prologis

Title:
Marketing Specialist

Location:
San Francisco Bay Area, CA

A day in the life

Prologis is seeking a Marketing Specialist to support the San Francisco Bay Area team by developing and executing marketing initiatives that strengthen relationships with customers, brokers, and the community. This role partners closely with the Market Officer, Leasing Team, Investment Officer, regional marketing, and Corporate Communications to deliver market-facing campaigns, events, communications, and branded materials. The Marketing Specialist also supports customer experience and community initiatives while coordinating multiple projects from concept through execution. Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to deliver high-quality work across a fast-paced portfolio of priorities.

Key Responsibilities Include

Develop and execute short- and long-term marketing plans for key market audiences in collaboration with senior leadership.
Create and coordinate branded marketing materials and digital content, including signage, brochures, email campaigns, invitations, social media content, portfolio tour books, stacking plans, pitch decks, and related collateral.
Manage marketing initiatives spanning product positioning, branding campaigns, Digital Property Marketing, broker and customer engagement, and department activations in partnership with cross-functional teams.
Plan and execute high-quality broker, customer, community, and internal events, including appreciation events, groundbreakings, celebrations, and volunteer activities.
Partner with Corporate Communications and market leadership to develop messaging, stories, thought leadership, and internal communications that support market priorities and enhance the Prologis brand.
Coordinate asset photography, marketing inventory, and site, building, and space-plan workflows with architectural, design, and other external partners.
Manage market marketing budgets, invoices, and departmental expenses, and provide project support across leasing, property management, development, capital deployment, and other market priorities.

Building blocks for success

Required

3+ years of marketing experience across a range of marketing functions.
Demonstrated project coordination or project management experience with strong attention to detail and consistent, high-quality execution.
Ability to organize competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling messaging.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite, including Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel occasionally to portfolio properties and event locations.

Preferred

Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience supporting events, customer experience initiatives, digital marketing, social media, or branded communications.
Ability to quickly learn and effectively use internal corporate systems and new marketing tools.
Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

Hiring Salary Range of:
$82,400 - $103,000. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

People First

Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. Individuals take the initiative here.

When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. Employees advance their careers here.

Leveraging AI tools and the full Verizon MarTech stack to deliver advanced relevance and personalization for all ABM and DBM assets.

Reporting out to peers and senior leadership on the progress and impact of ABM and DBM initiatives via a regularly-maintained dashboard.

You are a strategic marketer who understands the intricacies of B2B technology sales for Enterprise and Public Sector organizations. You are comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with sales teams and leveraging the latest technologies to gain an edge.

You'll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Enterprise and/or Public Sector B2B marketing experience.
Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM).
Experience creating and executing marketing programs and campaigns, and reporting results to senior leadership.
Experience building presentation decks that are clear and concise, with a focus on executive design and succinct storytelling.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Deal-Based Marketing (DBM) experience.
Ability to analyze results, identify gaps, and successfully pivot strategies to deliver outcomes.
Ability to build executive-level relationships and drive complex initiatives across matrixed teams.
Strong understanding of Verizon Business wireless and wireline products.
Deep familiarity with Enterprise and Public Sector buying motions, including how to identify, map, and influence key buying committee members across numerous industries and verticals.
Proficiency with AI tools and modern marketing technology stacks to drive personalization and deep account discovery.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

40

Position Type: Full-Time, 1-Year W2 Contract

Pay Rate: $86.00/hr - $90.00/hr

Cella is seeking a Senior Marketing Analytics Specialist
to lead sophisticated analytical initiatives for a global healthcare leader. You'll serve as a vital link between marketing and sales, turning complex data into clear, actionable insights that directly influence business decisions.

Responsibilities:

Conducting Advanced Analytics: Perform marketing mix modeling, ROI analyses, and promotional responsiveness evaluations across digital, virtual, and traditional sales force channels.
Optimizing Brand Strategy: Partner with Marketing and Sales teams to bridge data and execution, ensuring strategic insights directly inform call plans, digital campaigns, and commercial resource allocation.
Analyzing Digital & Field Campaigns: Conduct ongoing, in-campaign digital analytics (covering email, banners, mobile, and alerts) and consumer database performance to optimize tactics in real time.
Integrating Disparate Data Insights: Synthesize findings from market research, forecasts, and deidentified patient claims data into unified, compelling strategic recommendations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate analytical findings effectively to internal stakeholders, ensuring data recommendations are fully integrated into business tactics.
Data & Vendor Management: Build departmental knowledge on analytical methodologies and collaborate with high-quality third-party digital agencies.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of marketing analytics experience using relevant industry data sources, OR Master's degree with 5+ years of relevant analytical experience.
Strong background working within a large pharmaceutical manufacturer (strongly preferred).
Hands-on experience analyzing large, deidentified patient claims data sets (strongly preferred).
Familiarity with CardioRenal Metabolic or other Metabolic therapeutic areas (strongly preferred).
Proficiency in statistical programming with R, Python, or SAS.
Strong expertise in data extraction tools (SQL) along with Excel and PowerPoint.
Demonstrated track record in advanced analytics techniques (multivariate analysis, promotional responsiveness, ROI modeling).
Experience with digital analytics (non-personal marketing tactics like email, mobile, banner ads) and consumer marketing databases.
Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex data into business recommendations.
Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple complex analytical projects simultaneously.
Must be able to work standard business hours aligned to the Eastern Standard Time (EST) zone.

Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential

This intern will join a team within Enterprise Marketing focused on creating and improving digital content that helps customers find, understand and engage with State Farm online. The team brings together content strategy, copywriting, SEO, AI search and web expertise to improve experiences across statefarm.com and other digital channels.

Lifecycle Marketing Lead

Team:
Marketing

Location:
Onsite, Los Angeles, CA

Full-time, Salary, Exempt

Senior Director of Marketing

About Plug

Plug is the marketplace for used electric vehicles. Consumers get an instant cash offer backed by battery-health data, and dealers across the US bid in real time on that inventory. Former Tesla executives founded Plug in 2023. We’ve facilitated $150M in EV sales and raised a $20M Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Why Plug

You’ll own a piece of the biggest automotive infrastructure opportunity.
You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
You’ll join an AI-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done from the ground up.
You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi-billion-dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
You’ll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes.

The Role

Plug is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Lead to shape how we communicate with customers at every stage of their relationship with Plug, from the moment they check their vehicle’s value through to close and beyond. Today, Sales, RevOps, BizOps, and Marketing split this work, with no single owner. This role is critical to the business’s growth.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll set strategy, write copy, and run execution from day one, with real technical depth in marketing automation. This isn't a production role that receives prewritten briefs. You’ll take an open problem from idea to measured result. You’re welcome to bring in support when it serves the work, and you can build and lead a team as the function grows.

What You’ll Do

Work with Product, BizOps, and Sales to understand the core issues across the funnel.
Lead lifecycle strategy, copy, and execution for customer-facing email and SMS, replacing the current ad hoc process spread across multiple teams.
Set up behavior-triggered flows to replace one-off sends decided manually.
Work with RevOps on the technical build. How much you build directly versus specify is flexible. Setting up triggers is part of the role.
Create the content plan and editorial calendar for customers, building trust and value over time.
Turn content into nurture journeys and track how well they move customers through their lifecycle.
Email and SMS are the first priority. Retargeting and on-site personalization (pop-ups, banners, personalized homepage content) are nice-to-have.

What Success Looks Like In The First Six Months

Set a clear operating rhythm for lifecycle campaigns.
Own a meaningful set of campaigns from strategy through results.
Launch a stronger nurture or onboarding journey with a defined test-and-measure plan.
Implement consistent briefs, segmentation rules, QA checks, and post-campaign reviews.

What You’ll Bring

6+ years in lifecycle or retention marketing, with experience setting strategy and running campaigns independently
Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms
Strong copywriting skills, with comfort writing and refining messaging from start to finish
Experience designing behavior-triggered, segmented campaigns
Experience working across functions with Sales and RevOps

Not sure you should apply? We’d still like to hear from you. If you don’t meet every item in What You’ll Bring but you’re excited about this work, just apply.

Performance Metrics

Funnel completion rate, measured by the reduction in drop-off between key moments in the customer journey
Reactivation rate and time to conversion for nurtured leads who return within the three- to six-month window
Email and SMS engagement health (open rate, click-through rate, list growth, and unsubscribe rate)
Conversion influenced by lifecycle touchpoints

added.title: Sr Product Marketing Mgr, Go-To-Market
added.description:
ABOUT OBLQ

OBLQ builds software for independent insurance agencies, providing technology solutions that help independent P&Cs operate more efficiently and grow faster. We handle the technology so agencies can focus on selling policies and driving revenue. Learn more at oblq.ai.

Same Team. More Agency.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help turn our products that deliver for existing customers into a company and category that independent insurance agencies know about, understand, and want to buy.

You'll work directly with the founders and stay close to both the product and our customers. You'll learn how independent agencies operate, what slows their teams down, why they buy, what makes them skeptical, and how OBLQ changes the economics of their business. Then you'll turn those insights into the way we go to market.

You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and much of the content that connects OBLQ to the market.

This is an early-stage role. We have products our customers love, we have great data and measurable results, a brand, and a point of view. We need someone who can take those raw materials and build a repeatable product marketing engine around them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Position OBLQ and its products.
Develop clear positioning and messaging for OBLQs current and future products. Understand what matters to agency owners & agents, and translate complex product capabilities into simple reasons to care.

Own the product story.
Make sure our website, social presence, sales materials, demos, campaigns, and product launches tell a consistent and compelling story.

Know the customer.
Spend time with independent agency owners and agents. Understand how they generate leads, quote business, work with carriers, use their CRM, follow up with customers, and make technology decisions.

Turn customer outcomes into proof.
Build case studies, customer stories, ROI narratives, testimonials, and other evidence that helps prospective customers understand what OBLQ can do for their agency.

Build sales enablement.
Give the people selling OBLQ what they need to have better conversations: messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive positioning, objection handling, demo narratives, follow-up materials, and customer-specific stories.

Own product launches.
Create the go-to-market plan for new capabilities, carrier integrations, product releases, and future OBLQ products. Define the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.

Understand the market.
Know the insurance technology landscape, the alternatives agencies use today, and where OBLQ fits. Track competitors, comparative raters, agency management systems, CRMs, automation products, and emerging technologies that could change the market.

Build content that earns attention.
Create and manage content for the channels where our customers spend time. That may include LinkedIn, customer email, website content, product education, thought leadership, webinars, industry communities, and other formats we discover work.

Improve how we generate demand.
Work across organic, outbound, partnerships, referrals, and paid acquisition to understand which messages and channels create qualified interest. Test quickly, measure results, and keep what works.

Bring the market back into the product.
You won't own the product roadmap, but you'll have an important voice in it. Bring customer feedback, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, and market signals back into product decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have experience marketing B2B software products and can show examples where your work changed how a product was understood, sold, adopted, or launched.

You know how to find the useful insight inside a customer conversation and turn it into positioning or messaging people actually understand.

You can explain a complicated product simply without stripping away what makes it valuable.

You understand the difference between describing a feature and explaining why someone should care about it.

You're comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work. At this stage, you may define the launch plan in the morning and write the landing page in the afternoon.

You can work closely with product and engineering teams and become technically fluent enough to market what we're building accurately.

You use data to evaluate your work. You care about pipeline, conversion, engagement, adoption, and revenue more than impressions for their own sake.

You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.

You have strong judgment about brand and messaging. You know when something needs another round of thinking and when it just needs to get into the market so we can learn.

SKILLS WE'RE INTERESTED IN

Working with AI tools to accelerate research, content, experimentation, and execution
B2B SaaS or vertical SaaS
Insurance or insurtech (nice to have)
Products sold to small and midsize businesses
Workflow automation or operational software
Product-led or founder-led companies moving toward a repeatable GTM model
Sales enablement and customer storytelling
Launching new or unfamiliar product categories
Competitive and market research
Demand generation and lifecycle marketing

Insurance experience is not a prerequisite. We care more about your ability to understand a market quickly and turn what you learn into effective product marketing.

HOW WE WORK

Our development cycle is fast. New capabilities can move from idea to working software quickly, which means product marketing needs to stay equally close to the product and the customer.

We value people who understand the problem, form a point of view, communicate it clearly, put it into the market, measure what happens, and improve it.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A year from now:
An independent agency owner can land on OBLQ and quickly understand what we do, why it's different, and why it matters to their business.
Our positioning and messaging are consistent everywhere a prospect encounters us.
Customer outcomes have become credible stories, proof points, and sales assets.

added.title: Sr Manager, Brand Marketing- Nesquik
added.description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

As the Senior Manager, Product Experience (PX), Nesquik + Beverage Brands, you are responsible for how the brand is experienced through innovation, product, and packaging. By leveraging holistic consumer, category, and competitive understanding, you lead innovation and renovation initiatives, product and packaging superiority efforts, and launch execution that strengthen the brand across first and second moments of truth. Working closely with Consumer Experience (CX) and cross-functional teams, you help ensure brand experiences, product performance, and business objectives come together to deliver meaningful consumer impact and sustainable growth.

Anchored by Nesquik and a collection of well-loved beverage brands, this portfolio combines iconic equity with meaningful growth potential. The challenge is clear: ensure that our brands continue to play a meaningful role in the lives of consumers in a competitive, complex, and constantly evolving marketplace. This leader will champion the pillar's product strategy: accelerating Nesquik's growth by building strong brand fundamentals, driving an unrivaled product & packaging experience, developing breakthrough innovation & renovation pipelines, and serve as the marketing lead for key business routines.

Key Responsibilities

Consumer, Category, and Customer (3C) Understanding

Partner with Insights to create and apply consumer and shopper insight activities that inform innovation, renovation, product experience, and in-market execution, leveraging holistic consumer, category, customer, and competitive understanding to guide strategic decisions.
Partner with Consumer Experience (CX) to connect 3C understanding into executional outputs across product, packaging, claims, naming, and commercialization.
Provide strategic direction on where the brand and product can stretch through innovation and renovation, ensuring opportunities are grounded in consumer needs, competitive dynamics, and business growth potential.
Synthesize innovation dynamics and market performance to inform business reviews, forecasting, product improvements, and long-term portfolio strategy.

Innovation & Renovation

Lead 3-year I&R pipeline delivery across front-end innovation (FEI), scoping, concept development, commercialization, and market readiness aligned with defined I&R strategies.
Own product strategy grounded in 3C understanding, ensuring the innovation pipeline strengthens brand relevance, product superiority, and commercial impact.
Define requirements for innovation concepts, claims, naming, packaging, and commercialization deliverables that support successful innovation launches, relaunches, and product changes.
Oversee innovation pipeline performance, forecast assumptions, launch performance learning, and opportunities to optimize, scale, fix, or swap initiatives.
Lead launch readiness activities, including input for commercial selling materials, launch tools, product-related eContent, customer execution plans, and relaunch/pack/product change materials in partnership with Commercial Development teams.
Lead renovation initiatives across product, formulation, and packaging changes to strengthen product superiority, design-to-value opportunities, consumer experience, and long-term brand competitiveness.

Unrivaled Superiority for Product & Packaging

Lead the development and execution of product and packaging experience initiatives aligned to brand strategy, ensuring a superior consumer experience across key moments of truth.
Own renovation strategies for existing products, including quality, formulation, packaging, and pack experience changes that improve consumer relevance and product performance.
Owns packaging design execution, visual identity application, product claims, and production delivery activities, partnering with cross-functional teams to bring superior product and packaging experiences to market.
Partner with Legal, Regulatory, R&D, Supply Chain, and Brand teams to lead claims development, compliance processes, feasibility assessments, product truth standards, and execution readiness.
Product & Packaging initiatives that build consumer trust, transparency, brand credibility, and stakeholder alignment.

Unbeatable Value, Unmissable Visibility

Responsible for setting the overall price value strategic approach and desired state based on consumer category and customer insights.
Provide strategic direction and executional input supporting I&R integration into shopper plans (retailer media) and customer-facing activation priorities.
Own digital shelf execution strategy, including PDP content, product information, product storytelling, digital asset deployment, and content quality to ensure a consistent and compelling product experience across eCommerce platforms.

Business Management

Support monthly business reviews (MBP/MBR) for marketing, enterprise forecasting, and annual planning processes by preparing innovation inputs, new item performance updates, and recommendations that inform business decisions.
Own the translation of product and consumer research into actionable recommendations that inform business reviews, forecasting, portfolio decisions, and product experience priorities.
Prepare marketing forecasting inputs, including consumption data, new item assumptions, performance updates, and business changes, helping translate results into actionable recommendations.
Lead team in tracking and reporting of brand performance, innovation priorities, and key initiatives, ensuring visibility to performance trends, risks, and opportunities.
Lead development of the Brand Situation Analysis, Brand Plan, and MBS inputs, partnering across functions to synthesize product experience priorities, innovation architecture, pipeline opportunities, and growth strategies.

Talent Management

Champions the Nestlé Ways of Winning by setting clear expectations, role modeling desired behaviors, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture that enables teams to thrive and deliver business results.
Lead by example to motivate and inspire team to exceed performance targets
Actively communicate expectations and provide regular feedback against those expectations through a robust performance management process, working with each team member to evaluate performance, provide feedback and training.
Work with direct reports to build appropriate development plans and coach team to ensure that the training activities achieve mutual, agreed upon objectives.
Participate in talent recruitment and selection to staff the organization with the best people for current jobs, as well as future leadership, promoting workforce diversity
Fostering the sharing of best practices.

Qualifications / Certifications

University Degree (BA/BS) in Marketing or related business field
MBA preferred
In-depth knowledge of brand building management principles and practices.
Strong negotiation, agency management, and relationship-building skills.
Strong research and strategic analysis skills
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and manage agency partners.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to translate ambiguity into clear recommendations and action plans.
Excellent communication (both verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
Strong financial acumen and understanding of calculating risk/return on business decisions.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, lead projects independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Applications

Critical Experiences

At least 10+ years of work experience in brand or product management, marketing, or a related field
Proven track record in developing and executing brand strategy.
Demonstrated ability and initiative to drive cross-functional teams to deliver on collective brand goals.
Experience leveraging data, research and trends to generate insights to understand consumer behavior (IRI or Nielsen knowledge strongly recommended).
Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to develop creative/non-traditional solutions for challenging, undefined problems.

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer’s workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems.

In the 'Agentic Era,' the Marketing Cloud CSM serves as a Strategic Partner who is truly 'at home' in the digital-first world. You speak the customer’s language—fluently discussing ROAS, conversion funnels, and omnichannel orchestration—while navigating industry-specific challenges like peak-season scaling and privacy shifts. You act as a domain authority who understands that technology only succeeds when it is grounded in a deep understanding of the customer’s business challenges and market trends.

We are looking for candidates who have experience supporting customers in one or more of the following industries:

Retail Consumer Goods (RCG) – Partners with retail, consumer packaged goods, fashion, beauty, and consumer products companies to drive digital transformation, enhance customer experiences, and maximize value from e-commerce, merchandising, and omni-channel strategies

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Your Impact

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle
Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer’s business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.

Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder, ensuring platform stability and performance.
Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.
AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask ** effective diagnosis questions**, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

Minimum Requirements

10+ years of industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platforms, and Marketing operations.
Consulting: Strong ability to facilitate discussions, handle objections, and translate business goals into product experiences.
Strong ability to facilitate discussions, handle objections, and translate business goals into product experiences.
Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer’s business.
Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development
Drives long-term commercial success as a Sales Cloud trusted advisor, bridging the gap between front-line selling and back-office operations. Guide customers through the evolution of their Salesforce maturity, ensuring that platform features like Forecasting and Pipeline Inspection are leveraged to maximize win rates and organizational growth.

In Addition (required)

Cloud/Platform Requirements:

5+ years experience supporting customers or as a user of Marketing Cloud or similar Marketing tools

Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist, Engagement Foundations) certifications and/or Commerce Cloud training credentials preferred but not required.
Salesforce product certifications are a plus (AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Data 360 Specialist)

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications: Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist, Engagement Foundations) certifications.
Foundational Plus: Possession of the Salesforce Platform Administrator certification.
AI Readiness: Holds Agentblazer Champion Status or higher

Note: This role is office-flexible and the expectation is to be in-office a minimum of three (3) days per week. This is not a remote position.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

The Regional Marketing Associate supports the execution of regional marketing plans across AMER, working with all Regional Marketing Managers to deliver programs based on team priorities.

You will own assigned programs and tasks from setup through post-event reporting, using established playbooks, processes, and templates. Your manager will set priorities in partnership with the Regional Marketing Managers. You will be responsible for delivering accurate, high-quality work on time, asking for guidance when needed, and flagging risks early.

You will use AI and data tools daily to improve efficiency and inform your work, while remaining accountable for the accuracy and quality of everything you deliver.

What You'll Be Doing

Execute programs across AMER. Support all Regional Marketing Managers by delivering assigned events, campaigns and ABM activities using established playbooks, from setup through follow-up. Your manager will set priorities in partnership with the Regional Marketing Managers.
Manage program operations. Build registration pages, emails, landing pages and campaign workflows in the team’s tools. Coordinate paid social execution, vendors and logistics as assigned.
Ensure quality before launch. Review event setup, assets, emails and landing pages for accuracy, completeness and functionality before they go live.
Report on results. Maintain accurate program data, track agreed metrics and prepare post-event and campaign reports using standard tools and templates.
Keep the team informed. Maintain timelines and task status in Monday.com, and proactively communicate progress and changes.
Support budget operations. Track program expenses, manage purchase orders and coordinate invoices with Finance.
Use AI and improve processes. Apply AI and data tools daily to work more efficiently, validate outputs and share useful workflows and process improvements with the team.
Flag issues early. Bring risks, blockers, unclear requirements and competing requests to your manager early so priorities and next steps can be resolved.

What You'll Bring At This Level

Located in EST or CST
2+ years in field marketing, regional marketing or events
Strong organization and close attention to detail
Experience with, or fast ramp on, Splash, Zuddl, Salesforce and Monday.com
Comfort using AI and the judgment to validate its output
Clear written communication
Willingness to travel approximately 40%

Compensation & Rewards

In the US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $88,000 - $95,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs

100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

added.title: Director, Data Enablement & Analytics - Digital & Marketing
added.description:
About

Bloomingdale's makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable. Our mission is to guide and inspire customers to make style a source of creative energy in their lives. Across all brand touchpoints, from Bloomingdales.com to our stores and emerging customer experiences, every colleague plays a critical role in bringing our mission to life. Our inclusive culture values innovation, collaboration, diverse perspectives, and customer-centered decision making.

Job Overview

Bloomingdale's is seeking a Director, Data Enablement & Analytics – Digital & Marketing to lead the strategy, governance, analytics, and measurement capabilities that support the Digital and Marketing organizations.

This leader is responsible for ensuring the business has the data foundations, measurement frameworks, reporting capabilities, and analytical insights needed to improve customer experiences, optimize marketing investments, and drive business growth. The role oversees both analytics delivery and the enablement capabilities required to scale decision-making, including data governance, KPI ownership, measurement standards, reporting frameworks, and data quality.

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership, analytical expertise, and strong business acumen. They are comfortable influencing senior leaders, defining long-term roadmaps, developing talent, and translating complex data into actionable business recommendations.

Essential Functions

Define and lead the Digital and Marketing data, measurement, and analytics strategy, ensuring capabilities support enterprise objectives and customer growth priorities.
Own the Digital and Marketing data foundation, including governance, KPI definitions, reporting standards, measurement methodologies, data quality, and platform enablement.
Ensure the organization has the reporting, analytics, and decision-support capabilities necessary to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and guide investment decisions.
Partner with Marketing, Digital, Loyalty, Technology, Finance, Data Science, and Macy's Inc. teams to advance measurement capabilities, analytical maturity, and data enablement priorities.
Translate complex customer, digital, and marketing performance insights into strategic recommendations that influence business decisions, prioritization, and resource allocation.
Establish scalable operating models, prioritization processes, and team structures that ensure successful delivery of analytics and enablement initiatives.
Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team of analytics leaders and individual contributors while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and business ownership.
Champion adoption of advanced analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, experimentation, and modern measurement practices that improve decision-making and business outcomes.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Analytics, Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, measurement, digital analytics, marketing analytics, or related disciplines.
3+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers and developing high-performing teams.
Demonstrated success leading analytics and measurement functions within a complex, cross-functional organization.
Experience influencing senior leaders and driving data-informed business decisions.
Retail, ecommerce, digital, or customer-focused industry experience preferred.

Leadership & Technical Skills

Strong understanding of digital analytics, marketing measurement, customer behavior analytics, attribution, experimentation, and performance management.
Experience establishing analytics operating models, governance frameworks, KPI definitions, reporting standards, and measurement methodologies.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to evaluate analytical approaches, challenge methodologies, guide technical teams, and partner effectively with Data Science, Engineering, and Technology organizations.
Working knowledge of modern analytics, cloud data, BI, and marketing technology ecosystems.
Proven ability to translate analytical findings and technical concepts into strategic business recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities.
Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a bias for action.

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at bloomingdalesJOBS.com.

added.title: Customer Success Manager - Marketing Cloud
added.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer’s workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems.

In the 'Agentic Era,' the Marketing Cloud CSM serves as a Strategic Partner who is truly 'at home' in the digital-first world. You speak the customer’s language—fluently discussing ROAS, conversion funnels, and omnichannel orchestration—while navigating industry-specific challenges like peak-season scaling and privacy shifts. You act as a domain authority who understands that technology only succeeds when it is grounded in a deep understanding of the customer’s business challenges and market trends.

We are looking for candidates who have experience supporting customers in one or more of the following industries:

Retail Consumer Goods (RCG) – Partners with retail, consumer packaged goods, fashion, beauty, and consumer products companies to drive digital transformation, enhance customer experiences, and maximize value from e-commerce, merchandising, and omni-channel strategies

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Your Impact

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle
Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer’s business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.

Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder, ensuring platform stability and performance.
Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.
AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask ** effective diagnosis questions**, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

Minimum Requirements

4+ years of industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platforms, and Marketing operations.
Consulting: Strong ability to facilitate discussions, handle objections, and translate business goals into product experiences.
Strong ability to facilitate discussions, handle objections, and translate business goals into product experiences.
Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer’s business.
Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development
Drives long-term commercial success as a Sales Cloud trusted advisor, bridging the gap between front-line selling and back-office operations. Guide customers through the evolution of their Salesforce maturity, ensuring that platform features like Forecasting and Pipeline Inspection are leveraged to maximize win rates and organizational growth.

In Addition (required)

Cloud/Platform Requirements:

3-4 years experience supporting customers or as a user of Marketing Cloud or similar Marketing tools

Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist, Engagement Foundations) certifications and/or Commerce Cloud training credentials preferred but not required.
Salesforce product certifications are a plus (AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Data 360 Specialist)

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications: Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist, Engagement Foundations) certifications.
Foundational Plus: Possession of the Salesforce Platform Administrator certification.
AI Readiness: Holds Agentblazer Champion Status or higher

Note: This role is office-flexible and the expectation is to be in-office a minimum of three (3) days per week. This is not a remote position.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. added.title: Digital Marketing Associate - American Girl CRM
added.description:
CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

Job Description

The Opportunity:

The CRM Marketing Associate is responsible for supporting the execution of American Girl’s CRM programs across email and SMS channels. This role supports day-to-day campaign planning, production, deployment, and QA while using campaign performance insights to help improve customer engagement, business outcomes, and CRM channel performance against key engagement, conversion, and revenue goals.

This role will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Creative, Loyalty, Ecomm/Merchandising, IT, and external agency partners to deliver personalized, on-brand communications that support acquisition, retention, and lifetime customer value. The ideal candidate brings a balance of strong execution, attention to detail, and a data-informed mindset, with a passion for creating meaningful customer experiences.

What Your Impact Will Be:

Campaign Planning, Production & Execution:

Support the planning and execution of CRM campaigns across email and SMS, including promotional campaigns, product launches, and loyalty and seasonal initiatives. Support the maintenance of the CRM calendar to ensure alignment with broader marketing strategies, business priorities, and retail moments. Support development of creative briefs and partner with internal creative teams (design and copy) to deliver engaging, on-brand messaging. Provide input on messaging, subject lines, and creative to optimize performance and maintain brand voice. Coordinate campaign production across internal teams and external partners, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Support audience segmentation and campaign targeting to support customer acquisition, onboarding, retention, and re-engagement. Support the build, launch, and ongoing maintenance of automated lifecycle journeys (e.g., welcome series, browse/cart abandonment, post-purchase, loyalty, winback). Use customer data to support personalization efforts and deliver relevant, timely messaging. Collaborate with merchandising and site teams to ensure strong alignment between CRM campaigns and the on-site experience, contributing to a seamless omnichannel customer journey.

Optimization & Testing:

Support ongoing optimization of CRM campaigns through A/B and multivariate testing across subject lines, creative, messaging, timing, and audience segments. Monitor campaign performance metrics and share learnings to support future optimization efforts and overall CRM performance against business and revenue objectives. Conduct thorough QA across all campaigns, ensuring accuracy of content, links, tracking, and overall customer experience.
Support CRM performance tracking by contributing to regular reporting for campaigns and key business moments. Monitor campaign performance and help identify trends and opportunities to improve engagement and conversion. Partner with teams to incorporate CRM efforts into broader marketing plans and share performance learnings to inform future campaign planning. Assist in the development of performance summaries and marketing decks as needed.

Data Stewardship & Best Practices:

Maintain strong customer data hygiene and support ongoing audience quality initiatives. Ensure all CRM communications adhere to email and SMS compliance standards (e.g., CAN-SPAM, TCPA) and deliverability best practices. Utilize CRM and project management tools (e.g., Klaviyo, Monday.com) to execute campaigns efficiently and accurately. Familiarity with customer data platforms (CDPs) or marketing data systems is a plus.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

1+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or email/SMS marketing, preferably within retail or consumer products
Hands-on experience with an ESP (Klaviyo preferred) and end-to-end campaign execution
Experience supporting CRM calendars, audience segmentation, and lifecycle campaigns
Experience working cross-functionally with creative, marketing, and merchandising teams
Excellent written/verbal, time management and quantitative/analytical skills required
Familiarity with campaign performance metrics and using data to inform optimization decisions
Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills preferred

Key Skills And Competencies

Understands the importance of delivering relevant, personalized communication across the customer lifecycle. Understands how CRM communications support the customer journey and brand experience.

Executional Excellence:

Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills. Able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and quality in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Data-Informed Decision Making: Comfortable working with campaign performance data to identify trends and inform optimizations. Able to apply insights to improve future campaigns and support business goals without requiring deep analytical ownership.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams including Creative, Marketing, and Merchandising. Able to contribute ideas and recommendations that support campaign planning and execution.

Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Demonstrates flexibility, curiosity, and a willingness to learn and grow.

Additional Information

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:

You're someone who loves to experiment, track performance, and figure out why things work (or why they didn't). This role sits at the intersection of marketplace management, direct-to-consumer (DTC) digital funnel optimization, retention marketing, and strategic growth opportunities.
