We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

We’re hiring an Associate Manager, Influencer Marketing to build and scale a network of culturally relevant creators who can bring Instacart’s brand to life through ongoing, creator-led storytelling.

This role will help us remain relevant in the moments that matter, create a consistent pipeline of engaging social content, and unlock creator opportunities across Brand Marketing, Organic Social, Product Marketing, and our broader commercial ecosystem. By building lasting relationships, repeatable processes, and a more effective approach to creator partnerships, this person will help Instacart strengthen its presence across social, extend the impact of our marketing, and create a more sustainable engine for engaging consumers year-round.

Twelve months from now, this person will have helped establish a deeper bench of trusted creator relationships, a reliable pipeline of high-quality creator-led content, and a more scalable approach to activating talent across the business with clear learnings on how creator partnerships can contribute to brand and marketing objectives.

This is a remote-based role reporting to the Senior Manager, Influencer Marketing.

What You'll Cook Up In Your First Year

This is an exciting opportunity to build a scalable, always-on creator ecosystem that strengthens Instacart’s cultural relevance, extends our brand storytelling, and creates a consistent source of engaging content and creator partnerships for teams across the business.

Build a scalable, always-on creator engine: Establish and manage a consistent pipeline of 6–12 creator partnerships per month, creating a reliable cadence of culturally relevant content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and emerging platforms and formats.
Bring an established network and grow strong creator relationships: Come into the role with trusted relationships across creators, talent managers, agents, and influencer agencies, and continue expanding that network to give Instacart stronger access to established and emerging talent, more effective negotiations, and long-term partnership opportunities.
Deliver creator partnerships efficiently and responsibly: Own creator budgets, negotiations, contracting, usage rights, exclusivity, and performance tracking, ensuring programs launch on time, stay within budget, and deliver against defined goals. Establish clear measurement and reporting practices, using performance insights to understand what resonates, optimize future partnerships, and improve the effectiveness of creator investments over time.
Make creators a stronger resource across the business: Become a trusted creator partner to Brand Marketing, Organic Social, Product Marketing, CPG Co-Marketing, Retail Marketing, Legal, and other cross-functional teams, helping identify the right talent and creator opportunities for campaigns, product launches, partnerships, and experiential moments.
Keep Instacart ahead of creator culture: Proactively identify emerging talent, formats, platforms, and cultural opportunities, using performance data, audience insights, and social trends to continuously evolve how Instacart works with creators and shows up in culture.

How You’ll Spend Your Time

80% Always-On Creator Partnerships: ongoing relationship management, content collaboration, organic and paid content pipeline, giveaways, organic social initiatives
10% Trend Spotting: Emerging creator culture analysis, platform trend forecasting, identifying new creators and formats, social trends. Translate these insights into timely partnership opportunities and creative ideas that strengthen brand relevance and help Instacart participate in conversations that matter to our audiences.
10% Experiential Support: support the creator components of experiential programs throughout the calendar year

The secret ingredients we're looking for

You live and breathe creator culture. You’re chronically online in the best way and genuinely curious about pop culture, emerging social trends, internet conversations, and the creators shaping culture. You have a strong instinct for spotting talent before everyone else does.
You’re a relationship builder. You know the creator ecosystem and have strong relationships with creators, talent managers, agents, agencies, and industry partners. You know how to build trust, maintain relationships, and turn connections into meaningful, repeatable opportunities for the brand.
You know how to get a deal done. You’re comfortable navigating creator rates, negotiations, deliverables, usage, exclusivity, and budgets, and can find smart solutions that work for both the creator and the brand while maximizing the value of each partnership.
You’re an operator at heart. You can take a fast-moving project from idea to launch, bringing structure to ambiguity, staying ahead of deadlines, and managing multiple creators and workstreams without letting details fall through the cracks. You enjoy building processes that make great work easier to execute and scale.
You communicate before someone has to ask. You proactively share updates, manage up, flag risks early, close loops, and make sure partners always understand where things stand and what happens next.
You understand the bigger picture. You see creators as more than a channel and understand how the right talent and ideas can strengthen brand storytelling, cultural relevance, audience engagement, and broader marketing objectives. You can connect the right creator opportunity to the business goal it is meant to support.
You thrive in the pace of culture. You’re comfortable moving quickly, adapting when plans change, and collaborating across Social, Brand, Creative, Legal, and other teams to turn timely opportunities into great work that delivers value for both audiences and the business.

Must-have pantry staples (minimum requirement)

5–6 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media, experiential, or a related marketing discipline.
Demonstrated experience independently managing creator partnerships or campaigns from talent identification and outreach through negotiation, contracting, content development, launch, and reporting.
Strong knowledge of the creator and social landscape across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
Experience negotiating creator partnerships and managing budgets, rates, deliverables, usage rights, and exclusivity.
Established relationships across the creator ecosystem, including creators, talent managers, agents, and/or influencer agencies.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience managing multiple creators, timelines, budgets, and deliverables simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to proactively manage stakeholders and work cross-functionally.

Optional Garnishes (preferred Experience)

Experience with creator management, measurement, or social intelligence platforms such as Dash Social.
Familiarity with affiliate marketing and how creator partnerships can support performance and commerce objectives.
Experience supporting creator partnerships tied to experiential activations, events, or cultural moments.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

Turn Conversations Into Calls With a Brand People Already Know and Trust

Are you naturally great at building rapport, leading conversations, and helping people take the next step?

Do you prefer speaking with warm, engaged prospects instead of chasing cold leads?

If so, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

About The Role

We’re hiring an Inbound Appointment Setter
to turn social media conversations into booked discovery calls.

You’ll be speaking with private healthcare business owners from around the world who already know who we are, follow our content, and engage with our brand regularly.

These aren’t cold prospects.

They’re already interested.

Your role is to step into those conversations, build trust, ask the right questions, and guide qualified prospects toward booking a call with our team.

This position sits at the intersection of sales, customer experience, and community engagement — and plays a major role in driving company growth.

Who We Are

We’re Paul Gough Media
, a global marketing and training company that helps private healthcare business owners grow and scale successful clinics.

Our founder, Paul Gough, is a 5x Amazon best-selling author, host of a top-rated business podcast, and former professional sports physical therapist turned business mentor.

Over the last decade, he has built a multi-million-dollar company ($5M+ and growing toward $10M), helping thousands of clinic owners improve their marketing, attract more patients, and increase profitability.

We operate from offices in Celebration, Florida and Hartlepool, UK, serving clients across the world.

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, you will:

Manage inbound conversations across Instagram, Facebook, and online communities
Respond to DMs, comments, and story replies with speed, personality, and professionalism
Turn engagement into genuine conversations
Ask thoughtful questions to understand each lead’s goals and challenges
Guide qualified prospects toward booking a discovery call
Follow up consistently with leads who haven’t taken action yet
Re-engage inactive or “ghosted” conversations
Track conversations, bookings, and follow-up activity

You’ll also help create simple weekly story prompts designed to spark engagement and generate new inbound conversations.

What Success Looks Like

This is a performance-driven role with clear targets and measurable outcomes.

Successful team members consistently:

Book 15–20 qualified calls per month
Maintain a 75%+ show rate on booked calls
Influence 8+ program sales per month through strong pre-call relationship building
Respond to all new inbound interactions within 24 hours
Maintain a healthy pipeline of active conversations

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You:

Have experience handling inbound leads through social media or online communities
Build rapport quickly and communicate confidently
Can guide conversations naturally without sounding scripted or pushy
Understand how to move people from engagement to action
Are comfortable following up consistently
Enjoy working toward targets and being measured on performance
Stay organised while managing multiple conversations simultaneously

This Role Probably Isn’t for You If You:

Prefer content creation or design over direct communication
Haven’t previously converted leads into bookings or sales
Avoid follow-ups or feel uncomfortable asking for commitment
Are looking for a passive community management position

Compensation

Base salary: $40,000–$55,000 per year (depending on experience)
Monthly commission tied to qualified calls booked and sales influenced

This is a results-focused role where strong performance is rewarded. High performers consistently grow their earnings through commissions on top of a competitive base salary.

What You’ll Get

No cold outreach — all leads are inbound and warm
Daily access to engaged, qualified prospects
Clear KPIs and performance-based bonuses
Structured onboarding, training, and ongoing coaching
A high-performance team culture built around ownership, speed, and results
Career progression opportunities into senior sales or account management roles
Monthly team events and potential travel opportunities across the US and UK

A Final Word From Paul

“If you’ve ever thought, ‘I’d be great at sales if I just had better leads,’ this is your opportunity. We generate a high volume of warm interest every single day — we just need the right person to capture it, nurture it, and turn it into booked calls.

If you genuinely enjoy helping people, think quickly, and aren’t afraid to follow up, we’d love to hear from you.”

Ready to Apply?

If you’re looking for a role where you can make a real impact, accelerate your career, and help ambitious business owners grow successful clinics, apply now.

Build the engine. Don't just run the campaigns.

A fast-growing consulting firm serving healthcare practices is looking for a hands-on growth marketer to own lead gen and brand awareness end to end. This is a builder role: you'll set the strategy, run the channels, lead the team, and own the number.

What you'll own

Demand gen:
email, social, podcasts, and events targeting business owners, plus ABM, lead scoring, and nurture sequences
Digital and search:
the website, SEO, AEO, and GEO, so the brand shows up in Google results, AI answers, and tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity. Plus paid ads across Google and Meta.
PR and events:
media relations, press coverage, and thought leadership placements in industry publications. Plus live events, webinars, speaking engagements, and industry association partnerships.

expertise-led content and sales enablement assets that make the sales team's job easier

internal staff and outside agencies, held accountable to results
The numbers:

5+ years in B2B marketing with real ownership of pipeline results (selling to small business owners is a big plus)
Proven people leadership: you coach, set the bar, and hold it
Hands-on chops in Meta, paid digital, email/SMS, content, and events

a steady flow of MQLs that close, traffic and engagement climbing quarter over quarter, the brand showing up when buyers ask AI tools for answers, events that fill seats and drive revenue, and every budget dollar earning its keep.

Why this role:
you get full-funnel ownership in a specialized, fast-growing niche, with a clear path to broader scope as the company scales. You'll also own the full visibility stack: earned media, search, and AI answers working together.

This company values collaboration, innovation, and work-life balance. The culture is intentional, prioritizing a work environment where team members thrive.
